name: Marissa Joy Selvig
occupation: Self-employed musician and worship leader; director of the free food pantry for Foundations for Nations Ministries (as of September 2022)
education: B.S. in Speech Communication–Theatre Arts, with a minor in Musical Theatre Performance, University of Wisconsin–River Falls (Wyoming Tribune Eagle 2022 questionnaire)
prior_offices: Pavillion Town Council, 2017–2019; Mayor of Pavillion, 2019–2020
background: Marissa Joy Selvig of Riverton ran as the Constitution Party nominee for Wyoming’s U.S. House seat in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election.

In a Sept. 28, 2022 Wyoming Tribune Eagle candidate questionnaire, Selvig said she was 39, lived in Riverton, had been married 16 years, and was the mother of four. She listed a bachelor of science in Speech Communication–Theatre Arts, with a minor in Musical Theatre Performance, from the University of Wisconsin–River Falls; service on Pavillion’s town council (2017–2019) and as mayor (2019–2020); and a then-current role as chair of Riverton’s EDGE committee. She also described herself as a self-employed musician, a worship leader, director of the free food pantry for Foundations for Nations Ministries, and an avid gardener.
